requests.prompt: A refined minimalist editorial still life background for a three-panel panoramic crossword app campaign. Wide continuous composition, warm ivory handmade paper backdrop hex #F7F6F0 with extremely subtle grain. Across the bottom quarter only, one elegant forest green satin paper ribbon hex #213E34 sweeps gently from left to right with a few sculptural rounded ivory and pale lime square tiles hex #D8ED9D resting beside it, evocative of crossword squares but all completely blank. Soft natural studio daylight, delicate believable shadows, premium tactile paper and ceramic materials, serene contemporary design, restrained luxury. Upper 65 percent is empty clean warm ivory negative space for editorial typography and app screenshots to be added later. No letters, no words, no numbers, no logos, no devices, no interface, no plants, no chess pieces. The ribbon continues out both side edges, never forms a bow. Wide front-facing panorama, not a collage. Beautiful subtle material detail, understated, clean.
